families.name: Practice-area hub
families.description: Full-width image hero (h1 + tagline) > grid of 5-9 linked blurb cards > image CTA band > about split (2 photos + text) > second image band; two hubs add a partner-logo row

families.name: Standard text page
families.description: Title banner on photo > one column: h2 repeating the title, intro, short sections, bullets (optional side image, video, table); 24-722 words

families.name: Text page with accordion
families.description: Title banner > intro text > one or more Divi accordions carrying most of the content (FAQ, definitions, plan tiers); 362-1899 words

families.name: Link index page
families.description: Title banner > grouped lists of links (documents or videos)

families.name: Form page
families.description: Title banner > contact or order form (the form is the shared footer block on Contact; Order Title has its own)

families.name: Post listing (blog index and archives)
families.description: Banner or heading > stack of post titles (h2 link) + byline/excerpt > Older Entries link; blog uses the Divi blog module, category/tag/author use the WordPress archive with right sidebar

families.name: Video post
families.description: Right sidebar. h1 > video embed > short transcript/summary (100 Wistia 2014-2020 with 55-246 words; 12 YouTube-only 2024-26 posts with no text at all)

families.name: Article post
families.description: Right sidebar. h1 > running text with h3 subheads, bulleted/numbered lists; 5 'Vaughn Voyage' posts open with a lead image

families.name: Legacy template demo
families.description: Old Divi demo: banner > lorem ipsum or blog list > in-page sidebar block > Our Partners logos > map > hours > two buttons. Placeholder content

families.name: Eventin / plugin stub
families.description: Events plugin (and portfolio shortcode) pages with right sidebar, almost no content: stubs, 'CONTENTS', 404 'No Results Found' or 2-3 line event details

families.name: Home
families.description: Hero with 5 buttons > badge row > contact band > 3-up mission/values blurbs with photo mosaic

families.name: Team page
families.description: Banner > per attorney: photo, name, role, long bio, headed lists (Education, Bar, Memberships, Awards...), plus Board Certified section with accordion

families.name: Workshop landing page
families.description: Hero > 4 stat blurbs > CTA > upcoming events > video > accordion agenda > audience blurbs > CTA; 11 Divi sections

families.name: Calculator embeds page
families.description: Banner > six accordion toggles each wrapping a third-party calculator iframe

families.name: Empty page
families.description: Banner + h1/h2 only; no body content (Booklets)
